rows.note: Retain the literal citation ($\mathrm{Str}_\infty$ p. 84), already present in the original. The bibliographic refinement identifies Structure à l’infini des M_{g,ν}, cote 147. The main reader has verified the title on 147/004 (crops/147_scan004_L499.jpg), formula labels (292)–(294) on 147/176 (its three L499 crops), and manuscript folio 84 with the Scholie important heading on 147/177 (crops/147_scan177_L499.jpg). These local anchors support the supplied identification; the precise verso relationship is not independently established. The speculative cote-150 identification is earlier commentary, not text on this page, so decision b records a bibliographic refinement without attributing a slip to the author.
